title: Borland pulls AARO reports on baiting craft and taking them down

tellings.quote: And then I can begin to pull reports and briefings from Arrow and reports about baiting craft uh and how to take them down,

plain: A man named Dylan Borland says that in 2023, using access he had through the Defense Threat Reduction Agency, a Pentagon agency that deals with weapons of mass destruction, he began to pull reports and briefings from AARO, the Pentagon's current office for investigating unexplained objects in the sky. He tells Michels those files included reports "about baiting craft and how to take them down," which, if true, would mean the government has studied luring unknown craft and bringing them down.
